newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Minister says Russia may tighten budget further.
newsitem.headline: Minister says Russia may tighten budget further.

text.p: The Russian government, asked to rethink its 1997 budget, may tighten its paramaters further, cutting planned levels for income, spending and the deficit, Finance Minister Alexander Livshits said on Wednesday.
"It is possible we will make it even tighter," Livshits told reporters after the State Duma lower house of parliament voted to reject the government's draft.

"We will reduce incomes, spending and maybe the deficit. We are being asked to meet the president's budget outline and that has a deficit of three percent (of gross domestic product), while we have 3.3 percent."
Livshits said the government might be able to resubmit the plans in less than 10 days and he did not rule out the possibility that the budget could be accepted by the new year.
